label: I / L1 Region A free-OH motif
hbond_character: one nearly free OH plus one OH directed back to the H-bond network

label: II / L1 Region B upward motif
hbond_character: Region-B water connecting toward the dilute outer/weakly bonded side

label: III / L1 Region B upward H-bond motif
hbond_character: H-bonded Region-B motif with high-frequency/free-OH-like contribution

label: IV / L1 Region B parallel motif
hbond_character: dipole and OH bonds nearly parallel to interface; weak locally, coupling-active

label: V / L1 Region B liquid-oriented motif
hbond_character: bonded OH groups oriented toward the liquid/H-bond network

label: VI / L1 Region B connector motif
hbond_character: connector from Region B toward L2; mostly H-bonded with weakly bonded shoulder

label: VII / L2 negative bonded motif
hbond_character: second-layer H-bonded motif, opposite orientation to VIII

label: VIII / L2 positive bonded motif
hbond_character: second-layer H-bonded motif, partially cancels VII
